notes.title: Quadrober Simulator game release!
notes.content:
Greetings to all Quadrobers and not only!
Today we release a funny meme project - “Quadrober Simulator”
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268080

[previewyoutube=625fz9sXKrI;full][/previewyoutube]

An exciting adventure as a Quadrober awaits you! The player is presented with the challenge to survive in the unbearable conditions of modern society.

notes.title: BORING PATCH OF THE FIRST DAY!
notes.content:
[[b]Dear Scouts! [/b]
We read your reviews and solve problems in real boring time).
Corrections:
1. Added an autosave before the final Boss (if you are killed, you will appear at the checkpoint, hand over the square support to the durka, take a bat and show who is the boss in the house on the second attempt!) 
2. Other minor changes and improvements.

notes.title: ZERO-DAY PATCH!
notes.content:
Greetings to all Skoofs!
Releasing the first small fix, namely:

1. DirectX 11 is now enabled by default. If you have a steep graphics - we advise you to turn on DIrectX 12 and the picture with FPS will be better.
2. Now the quest with a horse can pass who did not work button 7, for example, if you took 2 bits.
3. corrected the output for the map. Inspired by the blogger https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i5-4W5aM_vM :-)
